description: This source file implements MQTT communication handling for web configuration, including thread management, MQTT connection status checks, message processing, and header creation for MQTT messages, specifically for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment.

methods.name: initWebconfigMqttTask
methods.description: Creates and starts the Webconfig MQTT thread.

methods.name: WebconfigMqttTask
methods.description: Main thread function for MQTT handling, including subscription setup and cleanup.

methods.name: getMqttCMConnStatus
methods.description: Fetches the MQTT connection status from RBUS.

methods.name: checkMqttConnStatus
methods.description: Checks MQTT connection status with backoff retries until connected.

methods.name: mqttSubscribeInit
methods.description: Initializes MQTT subscription via RBUS method call.

methods.name: webcfgSubscribeCallbackHandler
methods.description: Handles MQTT subscription callback events, triggers MQTT sync on success.

methods.name: webcfgOnMessageCallbackHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming MQTT messages, spawns thread to process payload.

methods.name: webcfgOnPublishCallbackHandler
methods.description: Handles MQTT publish callback events.

methods.name: triggerMqttSync
methods.description: Generates MQTT headers and triggers sync by publishing.

methods.name: setBootupSyncHeader
methods.description: Sets the bootup sync header via RBUS method call.

methods.name: convertToUppercase
methods.description: Converts device ID string to uppercase.

methods.name: createMqttHeader
methods.description: Creates MQTT headers with device info and system parameters.

methods.name: setPublishNotification
methods.description: Publishes a notification message via RBUS method.

methods.name: publish_notify_mqtt
methods.description: Prepares and sends MQTT publish notification.

methods.name: sendNotification_mqtt
methods.description: Public API to send MQTT notification if connected.

methods.name: get_global_mqtt_sync_condition
methods.description: Returns pointer to MQTT sync condition variable.

methods.name: processPayloadTask
methods.description: Thread function to process MQTT payload data.

methods.name: handleMqttResponse
methods.description: Handles MQTT response codes and updates system state accordingly.

methods.name: processPayload
methods.description: Parses MQTT payload data, extracts headers, and triggers config update.

methods.name: createMqttPubHeader
methods.description: Creates MQTT publish headers with content and destination.

methods.name: freeMqttHeaders
methods.description: Frees allocated MQTT header strings.
